name: programming-ime-vscode-bridge
description: Prototype: seven-language local suggestions and reviewed AI edits (BYOK). Not a replacement for a system TSF IME.

commands.title: Programming IME: Configure AI Provider / API Key
Programming IME: Set Model and Effort
Programming IME: F1 AI Edit (Full File / Insert)

programmingIme.enabled.description: Enable editor candidate provider and the F1 keybinding; can override editor F1 Help.

programmingIme.coreExecutable.description: Absolute path of a trusted, locally built pime-core executable. Empty uses JavaScript fallback.

programmingIme.realtimeAI.description: Send authorized context to selected provider for AI suggestions. Requires explicit opt-in.

programmingIme.endpoint.description: HTTPS endpoint. For openai-compatible use the chat/completions endpoint.

programmingIme.model.description: Explicit model identifier selected by the user; never silently selected.

programmingIme.effortCapability.description: Set supported only when provider/model documentation confirms a reasoning effort argument.
